title: My Shadow
description: NCERT Class 5 English (Marigold): 'My Shadow'. New words, comprehension, prepositions (where), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'My Shadow': shadow, follow, sunlight, shape.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'My Shadow' mean (shadow, follow, sunlight, shape); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In bright sunlight, your ___ falls on the ground.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To go after someone closely is to ___ them.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: My shadow walks beside me on the road.
The book is on the table, under the lamp.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'My Shadow' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'My Shadow'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the poem, the child's shadow always seems to ___ them.
In the poem, the child's shadow seems to ___ them everywhere.

exemplars: My shadow walks beside me on the road.
The book is on the table, under the lamp.

nodes.title: Prepositions (Where)
nodes.teach_focus: Prepositions tell where: in, on, under, behind, beside, between.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses prepositions (where) correctly in a sentence.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The cat is hiding ___ the box (inside it).
My shadow stands ___ me when the sun is behind. (in front of)
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: The cat hid under the box.
The book is on the table.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'My Shadow'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'My Shadow': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: On a sunny day, I see my shadow ___ the wall.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: My shadow stands ___ me when the sun is behind. (in front of)
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: My shadow walks beside me on the road.
The book is on the table, under the lamp.

items.prompt: To go after someone closely is to ___ them.
In bright sunlight, your ___ falls on the ground.
In the poem, the child's shadow always seems to ___ them.
In the poem, the child's shadow seems to ___ them everywhere.
The cat is hiding ___ the box (inside it).
